name: taipal
title: Taipal showcase
description: A finished bilingual sample site for a fictional architecture and interiors studio: home, services, cases with a case study each, team and contact pages in English and Brazilian Portuguese, with a designed theme, self-hosted fonts, its own photography and an enquiry form. Apply it to a new site to see what Viglet Shio renders.

pt-BR.title: Vitrine Taipal
pt-BR.description: Um site de exemplo pronto e bilíngue para um estúdio fictício de arquitetura e interiores: páginas de início, serviços, projetos com um estudo de caso cada, equipe e contato em português e inglês, com tema desenhado, fontes próprias, fotografia original e formulário de contato. Aplique em um site novo para ver o que o Viglet Shio desenha.

assets.alt: A long oak table with white card models, stone samples and rolled drawings beside tall steel-framed windows, in a brick studio in morning sun.
A white card model of a two-storey house with a timber-slat roof, on a green cutting mat beside a steel ruler and a craft knife.
A board-formed concrete house with a timber slatted screen and a deep roof overhang, on a grassy hillside above mountain ridges at sunset.
A narrow bakery with a vaulted plaster ceiling, terrazzo floor, oak shelves of bread and a long oak counter under brass pendant lamps.
A living room with herringbone parquet, white walls, a pale sofa, built-in oak shelves and open doors to a balcony full of plants.
The studio's brick room seen through a doorway: a long oak table with white card models and five wooden chairs, tall steel-framed windows on the right.
Head and shoulders of a woman in her fifties with short grey hair and round wire glasses, in a dark linen shirt, beside a steel-framed window in the studio.
A single-storey brick building with one tall glass door and a bicycle against the wall, behind a low iron railing on a tree-lined street.
